conflicts.where: Lessons 5 and 6 (column vectors w=(6;5) and s=(−4;−6)) versus Lessons 1, 2 and 7
conflicts.problem: The lessons contradict each other on the phenomenon. Lessons 5 and 6 use w=(6;5) with magnitude √61≈7.8 km and s=(−4;−6) with magnitude √52≈7.2 km, which are not 8 km and not equal to each other. Lesson 6 says these 'confirm the 8 km labels' and are 'close to 8 km', but the phenomenon is two journeys of exactly 8 km. Lesson 6 also calls them 'almost identical' when they differ by 0.6 km. The data cannot represent two journeys of exactly equal distance. Lessons 2 and 7 also give different directions for the South B journey (south vs south-east), and Lesson 7 says the Westlands journey is north-east while Lessons 1 and 2 say north-west. Lesson 5 puts Westlands at (6,5), which is east/north-east, and contradicts the north-west of Lessons 1 and 2.
